items.title: Larry Ridley interviewed by Monk Rowe, Toronto, Canada, January 10, 2003
items.q: But he was with Max Roach and was with Art Blakey.

ctx.x: You know, people sometimes complain that some of the younger musicians are being elevated to the place of having their own bands and leadership and their own albums and they’re only in their early twenties or something. But then you go back and say well Clifford Brown was a leader at a young age.
But he was with Max Roach and was with Art Blakey.
Well that’s my question. What was the difference?
